seoTitle: Online method acting classes for kids
seoDescription: Discover the power of Master Methods, an online acting class for young actors ages 9 and up. Learn iconic techniques from Uta Hagen, Sanford Meisner, Stella Adler, and David Mamet to transform your acting skills.
body:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to help your young actor unlock their full acting potential? The Master Methods class, taught by Youth Talent Manager and acting instructor Corey Ralston, is specifically designed for young actors aged 9 and up. This four-week online course will introduce students to some of the most powerful method acting techniques used by generations of prolific actors.

Throughout the course, students will learn one of these iconic methods each week. They'll explore Uta Hagen's focus on realism and behavior, Sanford Meisner's exercises that promote getting out of your head and into the moment, Stella Adler's theory of imagination as the only tool an actor needs, and David Mamet's Practical Aesthetics that uses a scene breakdown to connect the actor to the character's motivation.

Uta Hagen’s Nine questions for actor’s to use in character development.

Corey Ralston, a seasoned actor himself with over 35 years of experience, has found a relatable and accessible way to teach these techniques to youth actors. There is no need to wait until college to learn these proven methods. By giving kids the tools to master their craft now, they can open their minds, develop effective strategies, and increase their competitive edge in the TV & Film industry.

Classes will be held on Tuesdays at 3:30 pm Pacific starting May 16th. Each class runs about 50-75 minutes, and there is self-tape homework for the first three weeks. The class is limited to only eight students, ensuring personalized attention for each participant. The price is only $179, offering an excellent value for this transformative acting experience.

Don't miss this chance to revolutionize your young actor's skills and help them unleash their full potential. Sign up for the Master Methods class today!
